title: Count, then rewrite
notes: The same A and p, the naive way. Pass 1 counts 3 below, 3 equal and 3 above, so in B the 5s start at B[3] and the values above at B[6]. Pass 2 copies each value to its slot in B, then B is copied back: 18 comparisons, 18 writes and 9 extra slots. The result, 2 1 3 5 5 5 7 9 8, keeps each kind in the order it came.
